intro: A stolen tome draws Drusilla La Salle's attention in Northshire. Powers of the Void was kept in a restricted wing of Northshire Abbey's library until a novice took it while defecting to the Defias Brotherhood. Drusilla seeks its recovery for her own study of dark magic.

p: Powers of the Void was kept behind guarded shelves in Northshire Abbey's library. The abbey archives hold holy scripture and clerical records, along with scholarly works on shadow and nether energies. The tome was presumably penned by the archmage Khadgar. Because its subject was dangerous, abbey authorities kept the book under guard and away from casual visitors. That barred Northshire's warlock mentor, Drusilla La Salle, from browsing it without drawing the priesthood's suspicion.

A Northshire novice carried the tome away while abandoning his vows to join the Defias Brotherhood. As he fled into the neighboring vineyards, he took several valuable volumes from the abbey. Drusilla sends promising warlock initiates into the Defias bandit camp to recover the book from their tents. She wants the dark knowledge for her own study, and the effort tests whether an initiate has the nerve to bind otherworldly demons.
